name: Lago Loop
description: A scenic intermediate loop around the lake with some technical singletrack.
landscape_description: Lakeside gravel opening into chestnut forest; short rocky balcony sections with open views over Lake Como.
difficulty_notes: Two short technical rock gardens after the second bridge; walkable. Fine for confident kids on the first 4 km.

name: Rifugio Traverse
description: A demanding traverse linking two valleys over a high saddle, with a mountain hut near the midpoint.
landscape_description: Alpine meadows above the tree line, exposed ridgeline before the saddle, larch forest on the long descent.
difficulty_notes: Exposed 300 m section at the saddle — dangerous with snow or ice; not suitable for children. Carry water: no refill between the hut and the valley.

name: Famiglia al Lido
description: Flat lakeside stroll to the bathing area, with benches and picnic spots along the way.
landscape_description: Shaded lakefront promenade and meadows; pebble beach at the turnaround point.
difficulty_notes: Apt for kids, families, and strollers. Fully signposted; passable year-round.
